mentions.name: stelae.eu
mentions.description: A service that publishes content from a private WordPress editor as static site deployments, making sites more secure, faster and cheaper. It emphasizes anti lock-in, privacy respect, EU-centric operation, fair pricing, and a sustainable no-VC business model, with the current focus on improving visibility to reach potential users.
mentions.problem: Despite having a solid product, it is hard to reach the people who would love to use it, so the current effort is on becoming more visible.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on stelae.eu (private WP editor -> static deploy: more secure, faster, cheaper).
